{{DISPLAYTITLE:FEniCS Framework}}
'''FEniCS Framework: Weak Variational Finite Element Solvers'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
The '''FEniCS Framework''' is an automated finite element library engineered to solve continuous spatial partial differential equations using weak variational formulations.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Weak Variational Action Formulation (9.5/10):''' FEniCS translates spatial action integrals (<math>\int_\Omega \mathcal{L} \, dx</math>) directly into continuous finite element matrix equations using Unified Form Language (UFL).
* '''Maxwell & Continuum Mechanics:''' Exceptional for 3D electromagnetic field equations, vector wave equations, and vacuum stress-energy tensor distributions.
